narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I say the inverse of four is one over four, because inverse means flip it.
<bookmark mark='quarter'/>But a hop of one quarter square does not bring Tanvi back to the start.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The inverse has to cancel the move, so adding the two must give zero.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>To find an inverse, change the sign of the number, and zero stays zero.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. Tanvi hops minus twenty one squares on a long track. What hop brings her back to the start?
